newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC prices fall, turnover rises.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC prices fall, turnover rises.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market slipped on Monday, but cheaper small-cap stocks moved higher and overall turnover rose.
Traders said most prices of large-caps in the cement, oil refining and bearings manufacturing industries slipped further, continuing a downward trend from last week under selling pressure.
"Now is a good time to buy, with most of the big names down," one trader said.
He said the market would be dull over the coming days.
Three independent indices, computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation, fell on Friday's levels.
The VAB-RA all-share index fell by 3.6 percent to 6,042.5 points, BIG-OTC slid 5.8 percent to 4,347.96 points and CAS-RQ was down 6.63 percent at 933 points.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 249 to 169, while 187 stocks traded flat. But most traders said there was limited interest amid a general holiday mood.
"This idle time was to be expected during the summer. Everybody is waiting for autumn to boost trading," another trader said.
Cement makers were among the biggest losers, shedding up to 12 percent from their Friday levels.
Romcim cement manufacturer, which has attracted considerable attention recently, fell 9,000 lei to close at 94,000 lei.

Traders said they expected investors to come back to Romcim next month, when the country's main privatisation agency, the State Ownership Fund, will announce the successful bidder for the majority stake it holds in the plant.
Rubber manufacturer Rolast saw an unexpected rise of 100 lei per share and closed at 2,700 after it took a third of the day's turnover, with 2.29 million shares changing hands.
Overall turnover rose to 19.45 billion lei from 16.3 billion on Friday.
